note: Rustic campground in hardwood forest beside the 411-acre Mondeaux Flowage, part of the Mondeaux Recreation Area; the Ice Age National Scenic Trail runs through it. The sites sit back in the trees; a fishing pier is at the nearby Lakeview day-use site and a boat ramp is a short drive away. --Claude
summary: FS page, recreation.gov facility/rates, catalog and all 11 site photos read. 12 sites (catalog 11), $15, no hookups, 2 vault toilets, 5 reservable/6 FCFS, 14-night max, season (manual) matches, phone matches. Lakeview -> not waterfront proposed (no site photo shows water; nearest catalog site ~30-40 m back under canopy; FS: 'the sites need access to the water'). Drinking water conflict between FS and rec.gov flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview -> not waterfront proposed (no --AWH on it). None of the 11 recreation.gov site photos (001-012) shows any water - every one looks into hardwood forest, several leaf-off. On Esri imagery (220 m half-width) the only catalog site near the flowage is 8 (45.33131,-90.44718), roughly 30-40 m from the shore under continuous canopy; 9-12 are about 55-70 m+ back, and 1-7 have no coordinates (none of their photos shows water). The FS page itself says 'While close to the lake, the sites need access to the water' (sic, apparently 'lack'). The only support for a view is rec.gov's 'Shady sites are nestled along the Mondeaux Flowage' (prose). No qualifying source confirms a view from any RV site, so it goes down.

DRINKING WATER: conflicting official pages - FS 'Potable water is available at this site' vs recreation.gov 'Drinking water is available at Glacial Springs, located on Park Road (FR 1563)'. Stored potable_water true (derived) left alone.
SITE COUNT: FS and rec.gov prose say 12; the rec.gov catalog lists 11 (no 006). Count 12 written with the catalog gap in sites.note.
PIN: 45.3316,-90.4454 matches the FS page's point (45.331593,-90.445408), ~110 m north of catalog site 9 and within the loop area - OK.
STATUS: FS page shows 'Site Closed' (end of season) - no status.
